name: Eragh Mihalakis Studio
website_title: Eragh Mihalakis Print Design | print designer
website_meta_description: An illustration-led print studio creating distinctive print worlds for sleepwear, swim and resort brands. Rooted in storytelling, Eragh, the print designer, designs collections to move seamlessly across product, from hero pieces to supporting prints. The focus is on work that feels emotive, recognisable, and ready to build into a collection.

--> About | Eragh Mihalakis top of page Collection in LA in April. Email hello@eraghm.com to book in. Home Print Shop Custom Design About More Use tab to navigate through the menu items. Designer & Studio Owner Here you see me in my natural habitat, exploring with camera and ice cream in hand. Dedicated to finding pink walls wherever I roam. Dedicated to creating original & beautiful surface pattern designs to suit your brands authentic aesthetic. About the Studio We are a textile design studio based in Dublin, Ireland. We create inspiring and exclusive surface prints to help elevate your collection. ​ Each collection begins with the all important research phase. Taking inspiration from around the globe, t he studio owner curates a selection of moodboards to inform the direction of each range. ​ Our designers create original elements using hand painting, illustration and a sprinkle of digital magic. ​ The studio is committed to bringing you original, fun and beautiful print designs. Whether you are looking for refined feminine, wild maximalist or effortlessly romantic patterns - we have plenty of prints to suit your brands authentic aesthetic. ​ ​ ​ Register for access Hi, my name is Eragh and I run a textile print design studio in Dublin, Ireland. We are the one stop shop for all your print design needs. Here to help you elevate your collection with original trend led print designs. Register for access to the print shop or get in touch about custom work. Meet Eragh I am a print and swimwear designer hailing from the not so sunny shores of Dublin, Ireland. After completing my Bachelor of Design in Textile Design in NCAD in 2010, I traded in Dublin's quaint streets for the bright lights of London. ​ I started out designing swimwear, lingerie and nightwear for the UK high street. Over the next few years I saw my designs on brands such as ASOS, Topshop & Lipsy, as well as lots of indie brands, and it never got any less thrilling. ​ In 2015 I swapped London's grey skies for Rio De Janeiro's sandy shores and spent two years gathering inspiration whilst traveling through South and Central America. During this time I discovered the freelance way of life and the idea for the studio was born. ​ ​ She Loves... ...collecting seashells, making lists, ​the smell of hawaiian tropic suncream, mountain walks, ice cream for breakfast, nutella, palm trees, sparkling water, vietnamese iced coffee and last minute adventures. Hola, Hi ,Bonjour, Konnichiwa, Γειά σου, Guten Tag. Say Hello Send us a letter, a love note, a question, a playlist. We're here for all of it. hello@eraghm.com Find us on Instagram See the latest from the studio over on Instagram hello@eraghm.com ©2020 Eragh Mihalakis.
